author: tylergibbs
abstract: Runs ML research as a loop of pre-registered kill tests: ceiling first, kill line written before any number, test data proven unseen, cheap screen then dev gate then a fresh test against the published method, paired cluster-bootstrap statistics, and guardrails that stop rented GPUs leaking money. Distilled from a multi-week agent-run world-model research loop where near-duplicate test sets, weak baselines and single-seed noise each produced false wins.
